armies_of_renown.name: Allies of the Free Cities
armies_of_renown.text:
When you pick the Cities of Sigmar faction for your army, you can choose for it to be an Allies of the Free Cities Army of Renown. If you do so, use the faction rules on these pages instead of the Cities of Sigmar faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed in the roster options below. All units in your army gain the ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES keyword.
ROSTER OPTIONS
Any non-UNIQUE SIGMARITE units
For each Sigmarite unit you include, you can include:
Up to 1 ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES DUARDIN unit
Up to 1 ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES AELF unit
You cannot include Regiments of Renown
You must include 1 SIGMARITE unit for each AELF unit and each DUARDIN unit you include.

battle_traits.name: Form Up, Allies!
battle_traits.declare:
Pick a friendly ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES unit to use this ability, then pick 2 other visible friendly ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES units wholly within 12" of it to be the targets.
The unit using this ability and the targets:
• cannot be under orders
• must each be a different unit type.
battle_traits.effect: For the rest of the battle round, the unit using this ability and the targets are under orders.

options.name: Designer’s Note
options.text: 'Unit type' refers to the name of the warscroll (Core Rules, 4.0), e.g. 'Freeguild Cavalier-Marshal' or 'Allies of the Free Cities Auric Hearthguard'.

battle_traits.name: Forces of Order
battle_traits.effect:
While 3 friendly ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES units are wholly within 12" of each other and 1 of those units has the AELF keyword, 1 of those units has the DUARDIN keyword, and 1 of those units has the SIGMARITE keyword:
• Those units have WARD (5+) against shooting attacks.
• Add 3 to those units' control scores.
• Add 1 to wound rolls for those units' combat attacks.

entries.name: Respected Commander
entries.timing: Reaction: You declared the 'Redeploy' command for a visible ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES unit wholly within 18" of this unit
entries.effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.

entries.name: Signet of the City
entries.declare: Pick this unit and each visible friendly ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES unit wholly within 18" of this unit to be the targets.
entries.effect:
For the rest of the turn:
• The targets are under orders.
• The targets have WARD (6+).
• The targets have a maximum control score of 1.

entries.name: These Realms Are Ours
entries.declare: Pick a friendly ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES WIZARD to cast this spell, pick an objective within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: For the rest of the turn, melee weapons used by friendly ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES units have Charge (+1 Damage) for attacks that target enemy units that are contesting the target objective.

entries.name: Divine Mandate
entries.declare: Pick a friendly ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, enemy units have a maximum control score of 1 while they are in combat with any of the targets.

battle_traits.name: Soldiers of the Fastness
battle_traits.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly GREYWATER FASTNESS units to be the targets.
battle_traits.effect: Until the start of the next battle round, the targets are under orders.

battle_traits.name: Ceaseless Salvoes
battle_traits.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by shooting attacks made by a friendly GREYWATER FASTNESS unit that is under orders to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target is pinned.

options.name: Designer’s Note
options.text: Greywater Fastness armies can get benefits for attacking pinned enemy units and can also inflict some nasty debilitating effects on those units too.

battle_traits.name: A Greywater Welcome
battle_traits.declare: Pick up to 2 friendly non-HERO GREYWATER FASTNESS units that do not have a firing drill to be the targets.
battle_traits.effect: Give each target a different Firing Drill.

options.name: Designer’s Note
options.text: The Firing Drills are given to the units during the deployment phase not during army composition.

entries.name: The Predicament
entries.effect: Melee weapons used for combat attacks made by this unit that target a pinned enemy unit have Crit (2 Hits).

entries.name: Seat on the Council
entries.declare: Pick a visible friendly GREYWATER FASTNESS unit that is wholly within 12" of this unit, that is under orders and that has a Firing Drill to be the target.
entries.effect: The target can use its Firing Drill ability this turn even if it has already used it this battle.

entries.name: Close-range Salvo!
entries.effect: If this unit is under orders, for the rest of the phase, this unit's ranged weapons have Shoot in Combat.

entries.name: Deafen Them with Fire!
entries.declare: If this unit is under orders, pick a pinned enemy unit that was the target of all this unit's shooting attacks this turn to be the target.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time your opponent declares a command for the target, unless they spend 1 additional command point to use that command, the command has no effect, it still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use the command are still lost.

entries.name: Hold Them Back!
entries.declare: Pick a pinned enemy unit to be the target.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, your opponent must subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.

entries.name: Repel the Enemy!
entries.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by this unit that target a pinned enemy unit.

entries.name: Hunker Down!
entries.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:
• Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks made by mpinned enemy units that target this unit.
• This unit cannot use CHARGE abilities unless it is under orders.

entries.name: Load Smokeshots!
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, this unit is not visible to enemy units while they are more than 3" away from it.

battle_traits.name: Blackshore Discipline
battle_traits.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly LETHIS units to be the targets.
battle_traits.effect: Until the start of the next battle round, the targets are under orders.

battle_traits.name: Under the Raven's Wings
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly non-WAR MACHINE LETHIS unit that has not already used this ability this battle to use this ability.
battle_traits.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:
• Ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for attacks made for this unit.
• Ignore negative modifiers to the Damage characteristic of this unit's weapons.

battle_traits.name: Strength from the Departed
battle_traits.timing: Pick a friendly LETHIS unit that has had models slain this battle to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: Pick 1 of the following effects. You cannot pick the same effect you picked in the previous battle round.

options.name: Stand Firm
options.text: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for shooting attacks that target this unit.

options.name: Purge the Unholy
options.text: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit in combat with the target. Subtract 1 from ward rolls for damage points inflicted by this ability.

options.name: Tireless Sentinels
options.text: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses a RUN ability, if you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.

entries.name: Raven's Eye Talisman
entries.effect: Enemy units cannot be set up within 12" of this unit.

entries.name: Acolyte of the Raven
entries.effect:
If this unit is not a PRIEST or WIZARD, it has PRIEST (1).
If this unit already has PRIEST (1), add 1 to chanting rolls for it.
If this unit is already a WIZARD, add 1 to casting rolls for it.

entries.name: The Raven's Protection
entries.declare: Pick a friendly LETHIS PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly non-WAR MACHINE LETHIS unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, each target has WARD (5+).

entries.name: The Raven's Blessing
entries.declare: Pick a friendly LETHIS PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly LETHIS unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect:
Roll a D3. On a chanting roll of 10+, use a value of 3 instead of rolling.
• If the target is damaged, Heal (X) the target, where X is equal to the roll.
• If the target is not damaged, return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic of up to X, where X is equal to the roll.

entries.name: The Raven's Price
entries.declare: Pick a friendly LETHIS PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly LETHIS unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Allocate D3 damage points to each target (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points), then until the start of your next turn, add 2 to charge rolls for each target.

entries.name: Hand of Demise
entries.declare: Pick a friendly LETHIS WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly LETHIS unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Amethyst Haze
entries.declare: Pick a friendly LETHIS WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly LETHIS unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from save rolls for units (friendly and enemy) while they are within the target's combat range.

entries.name: Bind in Death
entries.declare: Pick a friendly LETHIS WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, if an ability would heal or return slain models to the target, that ability does not heal or return any slain models to it.

armies_of_renown.name: The Iron March
armies_of_renown.text:
When you pick the Cities of Sigmar faction for your army, you can choose for it to be the Iron March Army of Renown. If you do so, use the faction rules on these pages instead of the Cities of Sigmar faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed in the roster options below. All units in your army gain the IRON MARCH keyword.
Commanders of the Iron March, Engineers of the Iron March and Iron March Auxiliaries are unique enhancements that can be given to IRON MARCH WAR MACHINES. A unit can only have 1 of each unique enhancement.
ROSTER OPTIONS
Cannonade Cogfort
Immolator Cogfort
Conqueror Cogfort
Linebreaker Cogfort
For each Conqueror Cogfort and Linebreaker Cogfort you include, you can include:
up to 1 Mallus Forgepriest
up to 1 unit of Freeguild Gallants
You cannot include Regiments of Renown or faction terrain

battle_traits.name: Form Up, Iron March
battle_traits.declare:
Pick a friendly IRON MARCH unit to use this ability, then pick either 1 or 2 other visible friendly IRON MARCH units wholly within 12" of it to be the targets.
The unit using this ability and the targets:
• cannot be under orders
• must each be a different unit type.
battle_traits.effect: For the rest of the battle round, the unit using this ability and the targets are under orders.

options.name: Designer’s Note
options.text: 'Unit type' refers to the name of the warscroll (Core Rules, 4.0), e.g. 'Cannonade Cogfort' or 'Mallus Forgepriest'.

entries.name: Castellan-Captain Vyan Philsin
entries.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly IRON MARCH INFANTRY while they are wholly within 12" of this unit and under orders.

entries.name: Commodore de Graçon
entries.effect: This unit and up to 1 other friendly IRON MARCH WAR MACHINE within this unit's combat range can use the 'Normal Move' ability as if it were your movement phase.

entries.name: Castellan-Captain Regan Vandercloud
entries.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
entries.effect:
Roll a D3. On a 2+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• The target has a maximum control score of 1 for the rest of the turn.

entries.name: Engineer Kirsta Loudren
entries.effect: If this unit is destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice for each visible unit (friendly and enemy) within its combat range. On a 3+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.

entries.name: Engineer Gurren Ashbrow
entries.effect: Each time this unit uses the 'Rally' command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

entries.name: Engineer Bartel Holst
entries.effect: This unit has WARD (6+) and STRIKE-LAST.

entries.name: Battle-Priest Solantra Whyl
entries.effect: This unit has PRIEST (1)

entries.name: Broadmoore and Louse
entries.effect: Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's Crew's Leadshotters. In addition, if this unit is destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice. On a 3+, you can set up a Freeguild Marshal and Relic Envoy wholly within 6" of this unit and not in combat. That unit has the IRON MARCH keyword.

entries.name: Master Sapper Gavelock Fiske
entries.effect: This unit's ranged weapons have Anti-FACTION TERRAIN (+1 Rend) and Anti-WAR MACHINE (+1 Rend).

entries.name: The Chant of Iron
entries.declare: Pick a friendly IRON MARCH PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick either a visible enemy unit within 18" of them or a visible friendly IRON MARCH unit that is wholly within 12" of them and that has not been picked to be the target of this ability this turn to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect:
If you picked an enemy unit:
• If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible enemy unit to be a second target.
• Subtract 2" from each target's Move characteristic until the start of your next turn.
If you picked a friendly target, Heal (D3) the target and the chanter. If the chanting roll was 8+, Heal (D3) each visible friendly IRON MARCH unit that is wholly within 12" of the chanter and that has not been healed by this ability this turn instead.
